body: Le prodige de 19 ans a lancé la rencontre après seulement soixante-dix secondes de jeu sur une offrande d'Alex Baena, récidivant son entame express réussie trois jours plus tôt à Wembley. en.title: Lamine Yamal shines as Spain cruise past Croatia in Nations League
en.summary: Lamine Yamal bagged a brace and an assist as Spain powered past Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday in the Nations League.
body: The 19-year-old sensation opened the scoring after just 70 seconds off a setup from Alex Baena, repeating his lightning start from three days earlier at Wembley. With eleven goals and seven assists in ten matches this season, the forward underlines his blazing form and keeps his national team unbeaten in forty games.

Autor de once goles y siete asistencias en diez choques este curso, el atacante confirma su momento estelar y sostiene a una selección invicta desde hace cuarenta duelos.
